blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Wednesday approved P116 billion in amendments to the P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget, adopting the redistribution recommendations of a select panel of ranking lawmakers. The House floor resolved through a division of the House whether to adopt the Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee’s (BARSc) recommendation to rechannel roughly P116 billion in amendments. The vote was by acclamation of lawmakers in plenary. The voice vote followed an objection by ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio, who opposed approving the budget realignments by substitution, arguing that the method lacked transparency. “A total of P116 billion was changed here, […]...
